kit.description: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.
让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。

MR Office — the open-source editors of the AI office suite closest to Microsoft Office: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and code in the browser.
